response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_games, total_games * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_games) FROM t) AS share_of_all, total_games * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(total_games) FROM t) AS ratio_to_average FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
